english.title: False statement to air navigation authority to retain identity pass - aviation
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), in connection with the continued holding by

(a)_[you]_
(b)_[another]_

of an identity document already issued and to which section 21B(1) of the Aviation Security Act 1982 applied, made to **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), the authority responsible for an air navigation installation in the United Kingdom, a statement which you knew to be false in a material particular or recklessly made to the said **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) a statement which was false in a material particular in that **(..SPECIFY DETAILS..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 21B(1)(b) and (5) of the Aviation Security Act 1982

english.notes: See also offence wordings: H2720, H2722, H2723 and H4226.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
